heading: Establishment of program

tree.heading: Program established
tree.text: There is established the National Vaccine Injury Compensation Program to be administered by the Secretary under which compensation may be paid for a vaccine-related injury or death.

tree.heading: Attorney’s obligation
tree.text: It shall be the ethical obligation of any attorney who is consulted by an individual with respect to a vaccine-related injury or death to advise such individual that compensation may be available under the program 1 for such injury or death.

tree.heading: Publicity
tree.text: The Secretary shall undertake reasonable efforts to inform the public of the availability of the Program.
